snippet.title: Project SongBird - Launch Teaser - FGS Live From GDC
snippet.description:
A Launch Date Teaser for Project SongBird, an upcoming atmospheric horror title from FYRE Games. After visiting a woodland retreat to help with writers block, you soon find out the woods aren't empty at all. Project SongBird is coming to PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on the 26th May 2026.

Wishlist Project Songbird on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180410/Project_Songbird/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
